items.text: Ngomnyaka wesibili wokubusa kukaNebukadinesari uNebukadinesari waphupha amaphupho, umoya wakhe waphazamiseka, nobuthongo bakhe bameqa.
Inkosi yasilaya ukuthi kubizwe izanusi labathakathi labathakathi lamaKhaladiya ukuze bamtshele inkosi amaphupho ayo. Bafike bema phambi kwenkosi.
Inkosi yasisithi kubo: Ngiphuphe iphupho; umoya wami wakhathazeka ukuze ngilazi iphupho.
AmaKaledi aseSiriya akhuluma enkosini, wathi: “Nkosi, phila kuze kube phakade; tshela izinceku zakho iphupho, thina siyakwembula incazelo.
Inkosi yaphendula, yathi kumaKaledi: “Indaba isuke kimi; uma ningangazisi iphupho nencazo yalo, niyakunqunywa, izindlu zenu zenziwe iquba.
Kepha uma nembula iphupho nencazo yalo, niyakwamukela izipho nemivuzo nodumo olukhulu kimi; ngalokho mangazise iphupho nencazo yalo.
Base bephendula futhi, bathi: “Inkosi mayitshele izinceku zayo iphupho, thina siyakwazisa incazelo yalo.”
Inkosi yasiphendula yathi: Ngiyazi ukuthi lizazuza isikhathi, ngoba liyabona ukuthi ilizwi lisukile kimi.
Kepha uma ningangazisi iphupho, munye kuphela umyalo kini; besengitshela iphupho, ngizakwazi ukuthi lingangitshela ingcazelo yalo.
AmaKaledi aphendula phambi kwenkosi, athi: “Akukho muntu emhlabeni ongatshela indaba yenkosi;
Futhi kuyivelakancane into efunwa yinkosi, futhi akekho omunye ongayibonisa phambi kwenkosi, ngaphandle konkulunkulu abakhaya labo lingekho nenyama.
Ngakho inkosi yathukuthela, yathukuthela kakhulu, yasilaya ukuthi kubhujiswe bonke abahlakaniphileyo beBhabhiloni.
Kwaphuma umyalo wokuthi abahlakaniphileyo babulawe; bafuna uDaniyeli nabangane bakhe ukuba babulawe.
UDaniyeli wayesephendula ngeseluleko nangokuhlakanipha ku-Ariyogi induna yabalindi benkosi owayephumele ukubulala abahlakaniphileyo baseBabele.
Wasephendula wathi kuAriyogi induna yenkosi: Kungani ilizwi lenkosi liphangisa kangaka? Khona-ke u-Ariyogi wembula le ndaba kuDaniyeli.
Khona-ke uDaniyeli wangena wacela enkosini ukuba imnike isikhathi nokuba abonise incazelo enkosini.
Khona-ke uDaniyeli waya endlini yakhe wabikela abangane bakhe uHananiya, uMishayeli no-Azariya le ndaba.
Ukuze bacele umusa kuNkulunkulu wezulu ngale mfihlakalo; ukuze uDaniyeli nabangane bakhe bangabhubhi kanye nabanye abahlakaniphileyo baseBhabhiloni.
Khona-ke imfihlo yembulwa kuDaniyeli ngombono wasebusuku. UDaniyeli wasembonga uNkulunkulu wezulu.
UDaniyeli waphendula wathi: “Malibongwe igama likaNkulunkulu kuze kube phakade naphakade, ngokuba ukuhlakanipha namandla kungokwakhe.
Uyaguqula izikhathi nezikhathi; ususa amakhosi, abeke amakhosi; Unika abahlakaniphileyo ukuhlakanipha nolwazi kwabakwaziyo ukuqonda.
Wembula okujulileyo nokufihliweyo: uyakwazi okusebumnyameni, nokukhanya kuhlala kuye.
Ngiyakubonga, ngiyakudumisa, Nkulunkulu wawobaba, owangipha ukuhlakanipha namandla, wangazisa lokho ebesikucela kuwe, ngokuba ususazisile manje indaba yenkosi.

Ngakho uDaniyeli wangena ku-Ariyogi owayemiswe inkosi ukuba abhubhise abahlakaniphileyo baseBabele; wahamba, wathi kuye: “Ungabhubhisi abahlakaniphileyo baseBabele; ngiyise enkosini, ngitshele inkosi incazelo.
Khona-ke u-Ariyogi washesha wamyisa uDaniyeli phambi kwenkosi, wathi kuyo: “Ngithole umuntu eziboshwa zakwaJuda ozotshela inkosi incazelo.
Inkosi yaphendula, yathi kuDaniyeli ogama lakhe lalinguBeliteshasari: “Ungangazisa yini iphupho engilibonile kanye nencazelo yalo na?”
UDaniyeli waphendula phambi kwenkosi, wathi: “Imfihlakalo inkosi eyibuzayo, nabahlakaniphileyo, nabathakathi, nabathakathi, nabahlola imihlola, abanakwazise inkosi;
Kodwa kukhona uNkulunkulu ezulwini owambula izimfihlo futhi uyazisa inkosi uNebhukhadinezari okuzakwenzeka ekupheleni kwezinsuku. Leli yiphupho lakho nobuso bekhanda lakho embhedeni wakho;
Wena-ke, nkosi, imicabango yakho yafika engqondweni yakho embhedeni wakho okuzakwenzeka emva kwalokho; futhi owembula izimfihlo uyakwazisa kuwe okuzokwenzeka.
Kodwa mina, le mfihlo angembulelwanga ngenxa yokuhlakanipha enginakho kunabo bonke abaphilayo, kodwa ngenxa yalabo abayakwazisa inkosi incazelo, futhi wazi imicabango yenhliziyo yakho.
Wena, nkosi, wabona, futhi bheka, kwakukhona isithombe esikhulu. Lesi sithombe esikhulu, ukubengezela kwaso kwakukuhle, sasimi phambi kwakho; nokuma kwayo kwakukubi.
Ikhanda lalesi sithombe laliyigolide elihle, isifuba saso nezingalo zaso kuyisiliva, isisu saso nezinkalo zaso kuyithusi;
imilenze yakhe iyinsimbi, izinyawo zakhe inxenye ziyinsimbi nenxenye yobumba.
Wabona kwaze kwaqheshulwa itshe kungengazandla, lashaya isithombe ezinyaweni zaso, esiyinsimbi nobumba, lasiphahlaza laba yizicucu.

Khona-ke insimbi, nobumba, nethusi, nesiliva, negolide kwachotshozwa kanyekanye, kwaba njengamakhoba ezibuya zasehlobo; umoya wazisusa, akwaze kwatholakala indawo yazo, netshe elashaya isithombe laba yintaba enkulu, lagcwalisa umhlaba wonke.
Nali iphupho; siyakuchaza incazelo yalo phambi kwenkosi.
Wena, nkosi, uyinkosi yamakhosi, ngokuba uNkulunkulu wezulu ukunikile umbuso, namandla, namandla, nenkazimulo.
Nomaphi lapho kuhlala khona abantwana babantu, izilwane zasendle nezinyoni zezulu, wakunikela esandleni sakho, wakumisa ube ngumbusi phezu kwakho konke. Wena uyikhanda legolide.
Emva kwakho kuyakuvela omunye umbuso omncane kunawe, nomunye umbuso wesithathu wethusi oyakubusa emhlabeni wonke.
Umbuso wesine uyakuba namandla njengensimbi, ngokuba insimbi iphahlaza, ithobe konke; futhi njengensimbi ewuqhekeza wonke, uyophuka futhi uphahlaze.
Wabona izinyawo nezinzwani, inxenye ilubumba lombumbi nenxenye iyinsimbi, umbuso uyakuhlukana phakathi; kepha kuyakuba khona amandla ensimbi, ngokuba wabona insimbi ixubene nodaka lodaka.
Njengalokhu amazwane ezinyawo ayeyingxenye yensimbi nengxenye yobumba, kanjalo umbuso uyakuba namandla nganxanye, uphukeke nganxanye.
Futhi lapho wabona insimbi ixubene nobumba lobumba, bayozixuba nenzalo yabantu; kodwa ngeke zinamathele ndawonye, njengoba nje insimbi ingaxutshwa nobumba.
Futhi ezinsukwini zala makhosi uNkulunkulu wezulu uyovusa umbuso ongayikuchithwa phakade; umbuso awuyikushiyelwa kwabanye abantu, kepha uyakuphahlaza, uqede yonke le mibuso, wona uqobo ume phakade.

Ngokuba wabona ukuthi itshe laqheshulwa entabeni kungengazandla, laphahlaza insimbi, nethusi, nobumba, nesiliva, negolide; uNkulunkulu omkhulu wayazisa inkosi okuzakwenzeka emva kwalokho; iphupho laliqinisekile, nencazelo yalo iqinisekile.
Inkosi uNebukadinesari yawa ngobuso, yakhuleka kuDaniyeli, yayala ukuba balethe kuye umnikelo womlilo namakha amnandi.
Inkosi yamphendula uDaniyeli, yathi: “Kuyiqiniso ukuthi uNkulunkulu wakho unguNkulunkulu wawonkulunkulu, neNkosi yamakhosi, nomambuli wezimfihlakalo, lokhu wena ukwazile ukwambula le mfihlakalo;
Inkosi yasimphakamisa uDaniyeli, yamupha izipho ezinkulu ezinengi, yammisa waba ngumbusi phezu kwesifunda sonke saseBhabhiloni lenduna yababusi phezu kwabo bonke abahlakaniphileyo beBhabhiloni.
UDaniyeli wayeseyicela enkosini, yabeka oShadiraki, noMeshaki, no-Abhedinego phezu kwezindaba zesifunda saseBabele; kodwa uDaniyeli wayehlezi esangweni lenkosi.
